' === CONTROLLERS (ORANGE) ===
class AuthProfileController #FFF3E0 {
 + Register(dto)
 + Login(dto)
 + UpdateProfile(dto)
 + LogWeight(weight)
}

class WorkoutController #FFF3E0 {
 + GenerateProgram(goal)
 + TrackSession(dto)
 + SetReminder(cron)
}

class ReportAdminController #FFF3E0 {
 + GetProgressChart()
 + GetPopularWorkouts()
 + GetAvgActivity(period)
 + ManageCatalog(dto)
}

' === GOF PATTERNS (GREEN) ===
class ProgramDirector #E8F5E9 {
 - _builder : IProgramBuilder
 + Construct(profile) : UserProgram
}

class StandardProgramBuilder #E8F5E9 {
 + SetGoal(goal)
 + AddWarmup()
 + AddWorkouts()
 + Build() : UserProgram
}

interface ICalorieStrategy <<interface>> #E8F5E9 {
 + Calculate(weight, mins, met) : double
}
class CardioStrategy #E8F5E9 {
 + Calculate(...) : double
}
class StrengthStrategy #E8F5E9 {
 + Calculate(...) : double
}
class YogaStrategy #E8F5E9 {
 + Calculate(...) : double
}

class WorkoutEventPublisher #E8F5E9 {
 - _observers : List<IWorkoutObserver>
 + NotifyCompleted(session)
}
interface IWorkoutObserver <<interface>> #E8F5E9 {
 + OnCompleted(session)
}
class AchievementObserver #E8F5E9 {
 + OnCompleted(session)
}
class ChallengeObserver #E8F5E9 {
 + OnCompleted(session)
}

interface IReportService <<interface>> #E8F5E9 {
 + GetUserProgress(userId)
 + GetPopularWorkouts()
 + GetAvgActivity(from, to)
}
class BaseReportService #E8F5E9 {
 + GetUserProgress(userId)
 + GetPopularWorkouts()
 + GetAvgActivity(from, to)
}
class CachedReportDecorator #E8F5E9 {
 - _inner : IReportService
 + GetPopularWorkouts()
}

' === DOMAIN ENTITIES (BLUE) ===
class User #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + Email : string
 + PasswordHash : string
 + Role : UserRole
}

class UserProfile #E3F2FD {
 + UserId : Guid
 + Gender : Gender
 + BirthDate : DateOnly
 + HeightCm : double
 + WeightKg : double
 + CalculateBMI() : double
}

class WeightLog #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + UserId : Guid
 + WeightKg : double
 + RecordedAt : DateTime
}

class Reminder #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + UserId : Guid
 + Cron : string
 + Channel : NotifyChannel
}

class UserProgram #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + UserId : Guid
 + Title : string
 + Goal : FitnessGoal
}

class WorkoutSession #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + UserId : Guid
 + TemplateId : Guid
 + DurationMins : int
 + CaloriesBurned : double
}

class WorkoutTemplate #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + Title : string
 + Type : WorkoutType
 + Difficulty : Level
}

class WorkoutExercise #E3F2FD {
 + TemplateId : Guid
 + ExerciseId : Guid
 + Sets : int
 + Reps : int
 + OrderIndex : int
}

class Exercise #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + Name : string
 + Category : WorkoutType
 + BaseMet : double
}

class Achievement #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + Title : string
 + Threshold : int
}

class Challenge #E3F2FD {
 + Id : Guid
 + Title : string
 + TargetCalories : double
 + EndDate : DateTime
}

' === CONNECTIONS ===
AuthProfileController --> User
WorkoutController --> ProgramDirector
WorkoutController --> ICalorieStrategy
WorkoutController --> WorkoutEventPublisher
ReportAdminController --> IReportService

ProgramDirector o--> StandardProgramBuilder
StandardProgramBuilder ..> UserProgram

ICalorieStrategy <|.. CardioStrategy
ICalorieStrategy <|.. StrengthStrategy
ICalorieStrategy <|.. YogaStrategy

WorkoutEventPublisher o--> IWorkoutObserver
IWorkoutObserver <|.. AchievementObserver
IWorkoutObserver <|.. ChallengeObserver
AchievementObserver ..> Achievement
ChallengeObserver ..> Challenge

IReportService <|.. BaseReportService
IReportService <|.. CachedReportDecorator
CachedReportDecorator o--> IReportService

User \"1\" *-- \"1\" UserProfile
User \"1\" o-- \"*\" WeightLog
User \"1\" o-- \"*\" Reminder
User \"1\" o-- \"*\" UserProgram
User \"1\" o-- \"*\" WorkoutSession
User \"*\" -- \"*\" Achievement
User \"*\" -- \"*\" Challenge

UserProgram \"*\" o-- \"*\" WorkoutTemplate
WorkoutSession \"*\" --> \"1\" WorkoutTemplate
WorkoutTemplate \"1\" *-- \"*\" WorkoutExercise
Exercise \"1\" -- \"*\" WorkoutExercise
